speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh, cousin Jeanie.

speaker: penny
text: Could you please drive a little faster?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, I think we're going sufficiently fast. What's that?

speaker: penny
text: Nothing. The engine does that sometimes.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That can't be nothing, the check engine light is on. We need to find a service station.

speaker: penny
text: No. The light has been on since I bought the car.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: All the more reason to consult with a mechanic before it explodes.

speaker: penny
text: It's not going to explode, just keep driving. Warp speed ahead, Mr. Spock.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Mr. Spock did not pilot the Enterprise. He was the science officer, and I guarantee you that if he ever saw the Enterprise's check engine light blinking, he would pull the ship over immediately.

speaker: penny
text: Oh, god, I'm gonna lose the arm.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, oh, red light, release accelerator and slowly apply the brake. Nailed it. While we have a moment, may I ask you a question? Why do you have the Chinese character for soup tattooed on your right buttock?

speaker: penny
text: What?

speaker: penny
text: It's not soup, it's courage.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, it isn't. But I suppose it does take courage to demonstrate that kind of commitment to soup.

speaker: penny
text: How did you see it? You said you wouldn't look.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Sorry. As I told you, the hero always peeks.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Anything?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No. That was the last pudding cup.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: No! What about Slim Jims?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: That's what he used to eat his pudding, remember?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Right! That was so good! Sweety and meaty at the same time.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Wait. Wait, wait. So you're saying we're out of food?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: The only thing in here are blue ice packs.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I know they're poison, but they look like big, yummy otter pops.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, god, I am so hungry.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Me too. Check and see if we have any more pudding.
